title:
The Lawful Captive
Shall Go Free
paragraphs: Some chains don't look like chains. They look like a contract you signed, a habit you agreed to, a door you opened yourself. The enemy loves that kind of captivity, because he can wave the paperwork in your face: you walked in here, so you stay here. Israel asked the honest question: shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered? Is there a way out when it's my own fault?

Heaven didn't argue the paperwork. God just answered: even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away. I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children. Your captor may have a claim, but God has a Covenant, and the blood of Jesus outranks every signature you ever made in the dark. Stop negotiating with the jailer. The One who carved your name on His palms has already said: let them go.
